title: Alexis P Suter Band - Love Always Wins

lines.l: Yeah, the smell I had slowly turned to a frown
Too many bad days gotta turn it around
I need to feel a little relief
I'm like a puzzle with a missing piece
Life is what happens to all of us
Just remember when the times get rough
I see the faces on the subway train
Everybody's dealing with so much pain
I wish that I could wave my magic wand
To give them all they need to carry on
When the door used to be open
Now it's slammed in your face
The grass you thought was greener
When the fog is so thick
